name: How do I choose the right size and location for my new gazebo?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right size and location for my new gazebo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right size and location for your gazebo involves considering its intended use and your yard's characteristics. For dining, ensure enough space for a table and chairs, plus comfortable circulation. For relaxation, factor in seating and perhaps a small side table. Measure your available space carefully. Location-wise, consider sun exposure throughout the day for optimal shade, proximity to the house for convenience, and views. Also, check for underground utilities, overhead lines, and setback requirements from property lines. A well-placed gazebo enhances both functionality and aesthetic appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select gazebo size based on intended use and choose a location considering sun exposure, proximity to your home, and adherence to property setbacks.
